metadata.title: About Ballard | Seattle since 1963
metadata.description: Ballard makes technical outdoor and work apparel to a working standard.

props.headline: A working standard since 1963.
props.description: Ballard began in Seattle's Ballard neighborhood. We use that origin plainly. The work now is making capable gear for current conditions.

props.heading: Condition. Construction. Fit. Tradeoff.
paragraphs: Those four points help you decide if a piece belongs in your day. They also keep us honest about what we can support.
When proof is missing, we don't replace it with confidence. The detail waits until testing and approval are complete.
props.markAlt: Ballard. Gear that earns its keep. Founded 1963.

props.heading: The facts we carry forward.
props.introduction: The approved record is short. We keep it that way rather than turning company history into a story it cannot support.
